title: Statistics and Probability
summary: Grade 10: mean, median and mode of grouped data, and theoretical probability with coins, dice and cards.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Summarising data and measuring chance help us make fair and informed decisions.

factual: How do you find the median of grouped data?
conceptual: Why can the mean and median tell different stories?
debatable: Should lotteries be allowed, given the probabilities involved?
